patch_list: HBO Max - Block SSAI Ad Origins

Reproduces the AdGuard DNS ad-block inside the app: fails media3 segment requests to HBO's SSAI ad origins (amer-free/emea-free.prd.media.max.com, gmss, FreeWheel) so the player's resiliency layer falls back to the clean, ad-free manifest…
HBO Max - Disable Ads
Suppresses nonlinear overlay ads (Bolt), SSAI linear ad timeline registration (GMSS/AdSparx), and live stream preroll ad timeline entry generation for all content types.
HBO Max - Playback Speed
Adds a remote-navigable on-screen speed control (0.5x–2.0x) to the HBO Max player. Opt-in; touches no DRM, ad, or network code. Not device-verified yet.
HBO Max - Prefer Ad-Free Stream

Loads HBO's own ad-free FALLBACK manifest instead of the ad-stitched PRIMARY one by remapping the stream selection in getStreamInfo (only when a FALLBACK stream exists). Ad-free on fresh start and resume with no markers, no timeline gaps,…
HBO Max - Remove Ad Periods (keep 5.1)

Keeps the normal PRIMARY stream (with 5.1 / E-AC-3 audio) but removes the stitched ad periods from its DASH manifest before playback. Overrides 'Prefer Ad-Free Stream' (its stereo-only fallback remap is switched off automatically). Fail-op…

patch_list: Block analytics & tracking

Stops analytics and tracking in the HBO Max phone app: Branch, Braze, comScore, Firebase/Google Analytics, AppsFlyer and MediaMelon. Blocking happens on the device, inside the app. Sign-in and playback are left alone. Opt-in / experimental…
Disable auto-updates

Stops the Play Store from silently replacing the patched app with the official version, which would bring the ads back. It raises the app's version number far ahead of the Store's, so the Store sees it as up to date. You can still update o…
Hide device identifiers

Gives the app a random per-install Android ID instead of your device's, and reports a zeroed advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you had deleted your ad ID in Android settings. The video DRM ID is left alone so playback works. O…
Hide VPN connection
Hides an active VPN from the app's on-device checks, so it sees the network the VPN runs over. The app can still tell from your IP address on its servers. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.
Remove social sign-in
Keeps Sign in with Google off in the HBO Max phone app. Email and phone sign-in still work.
Report Wi-Fi connection

Makes the app see an unmetered Wi-Fi connection when the phone is on mobile data, so Wi-Fi-only downloads and quality limits do not apply. This can use a lot of mobile data. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.
Skip ads

Blocks HBO Max's ad servers inside the app, the way a DNS ad blocker would, so the player falls back to its clean stream and the ad video does not play. On TV this sometimes shows "Couldn't Play Content" (error 39999) when a resumed episod…
Spoof carrier

Hides your mobile carrier from the app and the ad and analytics SDKs inside it, or reports a carrier name you choose. Carrier deals the app detects from your carrier will not work while this is on. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.
